claims.text: Tailored thermo-mechanical processing that retains and refines lamellae in eutectic high-entropy alloys can simultaneously improve strength and ductility.
The same processing can improve Young’s modulus.
The same processing can improve fracture resistance.
AlCoCrFeNi2.1 is an example of a eutectic high-entropy alloy suitable for the proposed approach.
The starting alloy is in a cast or near-cast condition with preserved lamellar architecture.
Tailored thermo-mechanical processing can produce an ultrafine-grained duplex microstructure that inherits the original composite lamellae.
The tailored process specifically includes precise rolling and annealing steps.
Benefits require processing parameters that prevent excessive grain growth and retain composite lamellar features.
The benefit is composition-dependent and may diminish when processing degrades the microstructure.
The processed alloy has an ultrafine-grained duplex microstructure with retained lamellar interfaces and hierarchical structural constraints.
The inherited microstructure provides a mechanism for microcrack arrest.
Lamellar interfaces act as in situ reinforcement and impede dislocation motion.
Lamellar heterogeneity produces hierarchical constraint and microcrack-arresting effects that enhance the strength–ductility combination.
Lamellar interfaces facilitate microcrack blunting.
Microstructural heterogeneity raises effective Young’s modulus by distributing applied stress more effectively.
Stress distribution, stress absorption, and microcrack arrest improve fracture resistance.
Relative to conventional processing, tailored processing will improve yield strength, ultimate tensile strength, and ductility.
Strength and ductility may increase by approximately 15–30% relative to conventionally processed samples.
Tailored processing will measurably increase Young’s modulus and fracture toughness.
Substantial departure from eutectic composition, excessive grain coarsening, scale-up problems, or process inconsistency may eliminate or limit the benefit.
